name: ma-seller-poa
description: Drafts a Massachusetts Seller's Limited Power of Attorney (.docx) from a Purchase and Sale Agreement: individual, entity, trustee, and probate estate sellers. A drafting aid for attorney review; not legal advice.

attorney_in_fact.title: Attorney in fact (required)
attorney_in_fact.description: The attorney every POA appoints, exactly as it should print, e.g. "Alex Q. Attorney, Esq.". There is no default: the skill refuses to build a POA until this is set.

signing_locations.title: Signing locations
signing_locations.description: Your firm's usual signing places, offered as a pick list for the notary location. Format: Label = County, State; separate entries with semicolons. The FIRST entry is the default. Example: Main office = Plymouth County, MA; Boston office = Suffolk County, MA. A Massachusetts county must be one of the 14. Leave empty to type the place each time.

signature_page.title: Signature page placement
signature_page.description: same-page (default): keep the signatures and notary block on the same page as the POA text when they fit. separate-page: always use a separate signature page. ask: ask every time.

default_notary_state.title: Default notary state
default_notary_state.description: Used when a place gives no state, and for the 'leave the county blank' option. The notary wording is Massachusetts wording; other states print a reminder to confirm it.
